entries.message: Site Controls can clear the open site's cookies or its cache. Clearing cookies signs you out of the site and removes everything it stored in that Space, including service workers and what sites embedded in it stored there. Both are also in the command palette and, on iPhone and iPad, the page menu.
Each Space's Privacy settings list the sites that keep data, with Remove and Remove All, and can clear history, cookies and site data, and cached files from the last hour up to all time.

Listing or clearing a locked Space's website data is refused until it is unlocked, Remove All clears every site's data in the Space, and the site commands on iPhone and iPad need a page that shows a site.
